description: Abwasserleitungsbestand des WAV Wittstock is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Representation of the wastewater pipeline stock of the Wittstock Water and Wastewater Association. Included are the levels shaft cover, protective pipe, protective pipe control shaft, posture, posture point, posture flow direction arrow, connecting line, connecting line flow direction arrow, connecting shaft, posture shaft, pipe top edge, material data change, barrier, branch and fitting. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wastewater pipeline stock of WAV Wittstock" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Heiligengrabe, Abwasserentsorgung, WAV, Wittstock, Stadt Wittstock/Dosse, Wasser- und Abwasserverband. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
